weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope_en: Aries, you might encounter some resistance today. However, there's a buoyant and uplifting vibe in the air that you can tap into. Remember, there's power in unity, so don't allow anyone to hinder your progress. It's possible that their objections are based on misunderstandings.

taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, what appears to be an ideal strategy might not hold the same allure tomorrow. It's wise to diversify your options rather than putting all your resources into one venture. There's a sense of abundance surrounding you, tempting you to get swept up in its current and follow its lead. Stay cautious of any schemes that promise quick wealth; you could easily be misled on a day like this.

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you'll find yourself amidst a whirlwind of excitement that you should embrace. It's like you're soaring on a magic carpet, floating high above the clouds. However, the key is to stay grounded and not let the thrill sweep you away completely. Remember, appearances can be deceiving; what seems to be going smoothly today might not hold up tomorrow.

cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, you'll experience a harmonious synergy with those around you. The bonds you form will be strong, so it's essential to anchor these connections in genuine meaning. Otherwise, you might discover that you've constructed a facade based on illusions. Stay authentic and be cautious of anything that appears overly enticing.

While it's wise to be careful, if a promising opportunity presents itself, don't hesitate to seize it.

virgo.horoscope_en: While it might seem like staying home is causing you to miss out on opportunities, Virgo, this choice is likely in your best interest. Others may be making grandiose promises that seem appealing now but are likely to fall flat later. Prioritize your safety and avoid pouring too much time or money into uncertain endeavors. Maintain a steady rhythm in your pursuits, and you'll discover success on your own terms.

Enjoy the festivities, but keep in mind that this exuberance could deflate by tomorrow.

Stay alert to any signs that could lead you astray. Others may adopt overly ambitious mindsets, tempting you with extravagant plans. Keep your wits about you and be wary of enticing but unrealistic promises.

Remember, even the grandest adventures can come to an end, so enjoy the ride while it lasts!

capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, stay focused today and don't let yourself be sidetracked by hollow assurances. Someone might attempt to entice you with offers that are as unrealistic as selling beachfront land in Iowa. Be cautious of anything that seems overly appealing. While chatter may fill the air, much of it is likely devoid of substance. Avoid getting caught up in meaningless talk; your time is better spent on more significant matters.

pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, you might struggle with trusting those around you. Listen to your gut feelings; they are likely spot on. Be wary of taking things at face value. If something doesn't resonate with you on a deeper level, it's best not to invest your time in it.
